CTRL_MRM_004.description: Traditional quantitative model validation criteria for non-agentic, deterministic ML components (e.g. CBF predictor coefficients, DoWhy causal model coefficients). In the EU, the governing framework is EBA/GL/2023/02 (superseding the ECB TRIM guide) and the ECB SSM supervisory expectations for internal model approval (IMAPA). SR 26-2 is a US Federal Reserve guidance document with no legal standing in the EU. EU AI Act Art. 10 imposes additional data governance requirements on training data quality, bias assessment, and data lineage for High-Risk AI systems.
